about_the_game:
Defend the Last Light

ELARIENNE is a wave-based roguelike defense game where you summon, combine, and deploy fighters to survive against overwhelming enemy waves.
Build your army with elves, humans, and orcs. Use powerful runes to customize your build and adapt each run to what the battlefield demands.

Summon Your Army

Start each wave by summoning fighters with a random race and tier.
Combine duplicates to create stronger versions, increasing their stats and unlocking new attack effects.

Survive 150 Waves

Enemies spawn in waves and follow a fixed looping path on the map.
If you fail to defeat them, they persist and stack with future waves.
Let 150 enemies accumulate on the field—or fail to kill a boss before the timer ends—and the run is over.
When too many enemies gather, the darkness overwhelms ELARIENNE and the world falls. Defend the realm before it’s too late.

Three Unique Races

Each faction brings distinct strengths:

  • Elves – Area magic and vortex effects

  • Humans – Ignite and chain reactions

  • Orcs – Cleaving melee and burst strikes

Mix and match to create powerful synergies.

Customize with Runes

Defeating bosses and minibosses lets you choose one of three random runes.

  • Bosses grant Attack Runes, minibosses grant Support Runes

  • Hold up to 5 of each type

  • Already full? Replace existing runes to adjust your build mid-run

Runes enhance attack speed, critical hits, damage scaling, and more—offering deep customization and replayability.

Exchange High-Tier Units

Tier 6 to 8 units can be exchanged into a random unit of the same tier but a different race.
Exchanges have a chance to fail, letting you keep your original unit.
Take the risk—or stick to what you know. The choice is strategic.

Strategic Map Defense

Deploy units within a square-shaped defense zone.
Enemies circle around your field on fixed paths, and your units attack automatically.
Efficient placement and race synergy are crucial to prevent being overwhelmed.

Randomness Meets Tactics

Every run is different.
Your unit pool, rune options, and upgrade paths are randomized—rewarding adaptability, planning, and creative builds.

Can you hold the line and protect ELARIENNE from the rising tide of darkness?
